name: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape
creator: SecretVerse Studio
redeem: Launch +1 Speed Keyboard Escape on Roblox and wait until you spawn on the map.
Click the Code button in the top left corner of the screen.
Type or paste the code into the box. BYP4SS1 uses a zero in the middle and a one at the end.
Press OK to add the Speed to your character.
notes:
+1 Speed Keyboard Escape is a speed obby from SecretVerse Studio set on giant keyboard keys, with a candy and chocolate theme in its current version. Every step you take adds 1 to your Speed, so the more you move the faster you get. You use that speed to run and jump across the key paths, but one bad jump drops you back to the start. Rebirths and multipliers help you gain speed faster, and you race other players on the server.

Codes in this game give raw Speed, which is the main stat you are always grinding. Besides the public code, the SecretVerse Discord has a #social-code channel where a Get Code button makes a one-time personal code worth 15,000 Speed, and it only lasts about 15 minutes. Liking the game and joining the group also unlocks a free gift. Public codes are rare and tend to show up with updates and events.

faq.q: How do I get the social code in +1 Speed Keyboard Escape?
faq.a: Join the SecretVerse Studio Discord, link your Roblox account, and press Get Code in the #social-code channel. The code is only for you, so redeem it in the game within about 15 minutes.

faq.q: Why does BYP4SS1 say invalid in +1 Speed Keyboard Escape?
faq.a: Check the characters. It is B Y P, the number 4, S S, and the number 1 at the end, all in capitals. If it still fails, you have probably already used it on this account.

faq.q: Is it better to use the Speed code before or after a rebirth?
faq.a: Speed from codes is a flat amount, so it helps most early on when your own speed is low. Using it on a fresh account gets you across the first sections much faster.

tips: Every step adds Speed, so keep moving even when you are not trying to finish. Running around near the start still builds your main stat.
Slow down before tricky jumps. At high speed it is easy to overshoot a key, and one fall sends you back to the start.
Use multipliers as soon as you unlock them. They make each step worth more than one Speed, which adds up quickly.
Turn your sound on. The keyboard clicks and candy sounds are a big part of the game's relaxed ASMR style.
useRewards: BYP4SS1 adds 15,000 Speed in one go, which saves a lot of steps. After you redeem it, try the sections you could not clear before. Since the personal Discord code also gives 15,000 Speed, using both gets you 30,000 Speed in total. An older public code has already expired, so redeem BYP4SS1 now in case it goes the same way.
